chapter.title: MAINTENANCE OF PUBLIC ORDER AND TRANQUILLITY

heading: Power of Magistrate to direct local investigation and examination of an expert.
text:
The Magistrate may, for the purposes of an inquiry under section 137 or section 138—
(a) direct a local investigation to be made by such person as he thinks fit; or
(b) summon and examine an expert.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Code of Criminal Procedure 1973, 02 of 1974 (Rep., Act 46 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
